tagline: Your strokes, shaped into a font.
sampleNote: Original scripted strokes for a working example. This is not a scanned handwriting evaluation.
tooMany: The text exceeds the 512 glyph limit.
charactersChanged: Changing characters removes scan assignments and keeps matching glyphs. Continue?
saveConflict: Another tab saved a newer project. Download this copy or reload before continuing.
storageUnavailable: Local storage is unavailable. Download your project to keep a copy.
storageQuota: Browser storage is full. Download your project to keep a copy.
templateHelp: Print at actual size. Keep all four crosses visible and use flat paper with dark ink and even light.
stageInstructions: Write one character inside each square. Keep the four registration crosses visible.
scanHelp: Choose page images, confirm each page assignment and visible page ID, then adjust the four corners.
cornersFound: The four corners were found automatically. Check that each marker sits on its cross before you confirm.
confirmPage: I confirmed the visible page ID, page assignment and interior alignment
resolutionWarning: Use a higher resolution only when the original image has enough detail.
replaceWarning: Mapped glyphs will be replaced. Continue?
previewUnsupported: This character is not in the project.
missingGate: Complete all glyphs or choose an explicitly labeled subset.
increaseSize: This outline collapses at this size. Increase glyph size.
invalidMetrics: Metrics are outside safe font bounds. Adjust size or offsets.
emptyFont: Add at least one drawn glyph before export.
woffError: WOFF2 setup failed. Try TTF export or reload the local app.
importFailed: The project could not be opened. Your current project is unchanged.
loadFailed: The sample could not be loaded. Your current project is unchanged.
invalidCorners: Move the corners into a valid top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left order.
wrongType: Choose a JPEG or PNG image.
tooLarge: Each image must be 16 MiB or smaller and decode below 32 megapixels.
drawHelp: Draw inside the square. Using a drawing replaces this glyph and resets its settings. Pressure follows pen hardware when available.
storagePersist: Keep this project available for offline use
noGlyph: Select a character to edit its outline.
sampleReplace: Loading the sample replaces the current project. Continue?
importReplace: Opening this project replaces the current project. Continue?
scanStale: The project changed during scan conversion. The staged result was discarded.
decodeFailed: The image could not be decoded by this browser.
invalidProject: This project is invalid. Your current project is unchanged.
invalidFont: The font could not be built. Check the selected glyph settings.
missingGlyphs: Complete all glyphs or choose the completed subset.
scanFailed: Scan conversion failed. Your current glyphs are unchanged.
popupBlocked: Allow the print window to open, or download the SVG template.
newProjectConfirm: Start a new project? Download this project first if you want to keep it.
recoveredPrevious: The newest saved revision could not be read. I restored the previous revision.
blankCharacters: Enter at least one supported character.
projectFileTooLarge: The project file must be smaller than 96 MiB.
duplicatePage: Assign each image to a different page. Convert a replacement in a separate batch.
scanCanceled: Scan conversion was canceled. Your scans and alignment are ready to retry.
scanComplete: Scans converted. Check each glyph before exporting.
settingsInvalid: Keep settings within their shown ranges and leave at least 5 percent of the crop.
offlineUnavailable: Offline files could not be saved. Use the app online and download your project.
paperSampleNote: Six letters cropped from a public domain NIST scan. I placed them into template cells for this example.
syntheticSampleNote: These strokes were drawn in code to demonstrate Latin, Han and kana editing. They are not a paper scan.
sourceHelp: Your original cell stays intact. Ink settings retrace it, while font metrics adjust the exported outline.
readyHint: Load a sample or start with the characters you want to write.
offlineFirstLoad: Open the app online once and wait until its offline files are ready.
pageLimit: A project has at most 15 template pages.
settingsHelp: Size is a multiplier. Offsets and spacing use font units. Crop values run from 0 to 1.
scanBusyWarning: Wait for the scan or cancel it before editing the project.
partialHelp: Only glyphs with ink will be exported. Excluded characters appear here.
savePending: Changes are waiting to be saved
templateWrite: Write inside each square. The lower faint line is the baseline.
templateRegistration: Keep the four registration crosses visible. Flat paper, dark ink, even light.
templateFooter: Template v1 / 5 x 7 / A4 / Print at actual size
privacyHelp: Your pages stay in this browser. Edit the letters, then download your font.
completeFont: All selected characters are ready. Download the font or refine a letter.
recoveryFailed: Saved revisions could not be read. Stored data is preserved. Download it before resetting local storage.
resetStorageConfirm: Remove this browser's saved revisions and images? Download the stored data first if you want to keep it.
secureContextRequired: Open GlyphSprout with HTTPS or a loopback address such as localhost. Plain HTTP network addresses cannot generate fonts or save projects.
sourceEditHelp: Touch up the source image. Existing ink stays at its original pixel size.
sourceChanged: This glyph changed while the source editor was open. Reopen it before applying edits.
discardDrawing: Discard the unfinished drawing edits? Apply them first to keep your work.
drawingUnsaved: Drawing edits are not saved or included in downloads. Apply or cancel them in Workshop before leaving.
scansUnsaved: Scan alignment is not saved or included in downloads. Convert or remove the staged scans before leaving.
setupUnsaved: Font name and character changes are not saved or included in downloads. Choose Project ready in Characters to apply them.
scanTemplateChanged: These scans belong to a different character template. Restore it with Undo or Redo, or remove the scans and upload sheets for the current template.
precisionHelp: Zoom for detail. Choose Pan, use the scrollbars or focus the canvas and press arrow keys to move. Brush sizes use source pixels.
scanRepair: Conversion finished. These cells need simpler outlines. Adjust the speck filter, crop or source:
wordSpaceHelp: Width of the space character in font units, from 100 to 1000.
matchBearing: Use this side bearing for all Latin letters
spaceInvalid: Word space must be a whole number from 100 to 1000.
specimenEmpty: None of the specimen characters has a glyph yet.
cssCopied: Web font CSS copied. Save it next to the downloaded font files.
cssCopyFailed: The browser blocked copying. Allow clipboard access and try again.
